description: Narrow on purpose: security fixes, a weekly lockfile refresh and grouped monthly Actions digests. Every other update waits on the Dependency Dashboard. Pinned toolchain and GPUI stay manual (CLAUDE.md, Pinned versions).

packageRules.description: Version bumps of Cargo dependencies: only when approved on the Dependency Dashboard.
Pinned together with the Zed commit; bumped by hand only.
GitHub Actions stay pinned by digest; one grouped PR a month.
schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month
